ValidationRule.description: If the RT is Broker WC, the type is Renewal, and the stage is Closed, a reason must be provided
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: (RecordType.Name = 'Broker WC Oppty' || RecordType.Name = 'Broker FRPSA') && (ISPICKVAL(Type, 'RENEWAL') || ISPICKVAL(Type, 'RENEWAL CONCURRENT') || ISPICKVAL(Type, 'CONCURRENT')) && ISPICKVAL(StageName, 'Declined') && ISBLANK(TEXT(Reason_Closed__c)) && NOT(ISCHANGED(Adverse_Action_Letter_Sent__c)) && $Setup.ValidationRules__c.Decline_Opportunity_No_Reason_Closed__c = FALSE
ValidationRule.errorMessage: You must enter a value for 'Reason Closed'
